test_adopt_existing_types: test the python function classes.adopt_existing_types() that adopts existing Python types
test_classid: test the python function classes.classid() that returns a class ID for an object
test_existing_types_adopted: test that existing types like int, float, str, bool, and numpy.ndarray are adopted
test_assertHasClass: test the helper method assertHasClass that verifies a class ID is non-zero
run_adopt_existing_types_test: run the adopt_existing_types_test.py test suite with absltest
